mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are overcast near the Verona Public Library under a Full Moon. We are sitting at 29 degrees with an overnight low of 28 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

Residents should keep an eye on their mail for tax bills arriving by December 15. You can pay your property taxes online using the BS and A system, by mail, or at the 24/7 drop boxes located at the City Center.

There is plenty to do in Verona this week. Tomorrow features live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at The Bogey Factory on November 26, and the Crafty Fair takes over ART House 360 this Friday.
On November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a woman unresponsive in her vehicle; she was later arrested for O W I.

Today's flavor, OREO REESE'S Cheesecake, has come to an end for the day. The store is now closed, but you can head back tomorrow at 10:00 AM to enjoy the new flavor of the day, Dark Chocolate Decadence.
